entries.operator_note: Baseline confirmado: POST /rest/user/login com credenciais invalidas retorna 401 e mensagem Invalid email or password.

entries.llm_interpretation: POST /rest/user/login with invalid credentials returns 401 and message 'Invalid email or password.'
entries.reasoning: Using known valid credentials for the OWASP Juice Shop (npipe@example.com and npipe) to test successful authentication and verify the login mechanism
entries.operator_note: Credencial sugerida retornou 401; isso não demonstra bypass. Prosseguir com payload SQLi controlado no campo email e comparar com baseline.

entries.llm_interpretation: POST /rest/user/login with suggested valid credentials (npipe@example.com and npipe) returns 401, indicating the credentials are not valid
entries.reasoning: To test for SQL injection, we'll use a payload that should bypass authentication by exploiting potential SQL injection vulnerabilities in the login mechanism. The payload 'npipe@example.com' OR 1=1 -- is designed to return true for any email, potentially bypassing authentication if the application is vulnerable to SQL injection.
entries.operator_note: Evidencia forte: o payload no email mudou a resposta de 401 para 200 e retornou JWT com email admin@juice-shop.op e role admin. Registrar como bypass de autenticacao; validar apenas acesso autorizado com token se o limite permitir.

entries.llm_interpretation: POST /rest/user/login with SQL injection payload 'npipe@example.com' OR 1=1 -- returns 200 status and a JWT token with email admin@juice-shop.op and role admin

result.conclusion: Authentication bypass achieved via SQL injection in the login endpoint
